workflow: Author a complete rich note end-to-end
ordered_actions: New Note → open editor → title+subtitle → body with heading, bullet list, table (2x2 + add row), code block, image with alt/caption via dialog, inline link → wait for autosave → Back → reopen
expected_intermediate: Dirty state tracked; image alt/caption staged then inserted; anchor applied to selection; autosave fires (~800ms debounce) without any manual Save button
expected_final: Reopened note shows every element intact (heading/list/table/code/img[alt]/figcaption/a[href])
notes: No manual Save exists in the editor — autosave only (verified Phase 2)

workflow: Web capture journey (save-page → queued → captured → artifacts)
initial_state: Library view; host permission for the target pre-seeded in the profile
ordered_actions: Save a web page… → URL → Save page → note card appears → link queued → queue processes → capture completes → card indicator "Link" → open note → Snapshots panel → screenshot + extracted text preview → Export PNG… / Export text…
expected_intermediate: Note created immediately; link transitions queued→captured; snapshot stores PNG + text (MHTML partial honestly disclosed, L05)
expected_final: Captured note with snapshot artifacts; exports download; card shows link indicator
must_persist: Note + link (state captured) + snapshot (png/text) + audit trail

workflow: Note file export → import round-trip
ordered_actions: Open note → File menu → export note file (JSON) → download lands → Import a note file… with the exported file → new card appears
expected_intermediate: Export downloads the lnwa-note envelope; import validates format/version/note
expected_final: Imported note matches source title/body/tags; a second independent note exists
notes: Phase 2 proved the envelope shape: format lnwa-note / version 1 / note{title,plainText,editorDoc}

workflow: Reminder lifecycle (create → chip → snooze → complete)
initial_state: A note exists in the editor
ordered_actions: Reminders panel → Add reminder… → one-time future → save → card chip "Due …" → panel Snooze… preset → chip "Snoozed until …" → Complete → row Completed
expected_intermediate: Chip labels follow reminder state transitions on the card and panel
expected_final: Reminder completes; history honest; chip reflects completed state

workflow: Restructure an existing note (align, table ops, find/replace)
initial_state: A note with text + table exists (from WF-01)
ordered_actions: Open note → select paragraph → Align justify → add table row → Ctrl+F → replace all → wait autosave → reopen
expected_intermediate: Each edit reflected immediately; find/replace narrows matches; autosave silent
expected_final: Reopened note keeps alignment, extra row, replaced text

workflow: Bulk organize (select → tag → favorite → archive → restore)
ordered_actions: Select 3 cards via checkboxes → bulk bar → Assign tag… → Favorite → Archive → smart list Archived → verify → Restore → back to All notes
expected_intermediate: Bulk bar counts update; each action applies to all selected; archived cards leave All notes
expected_final: Restored notes back in All notes with tag + favorite intact

workflow: Trash lifecycle (trash → restore → trash → empty)
ordered_actions: Open note → Move to trash… → confirm → Trash smart list shows it → Restore → trash again → Empty trash → confirm → gone
expected_intermediate: Confirm dialogs at each destructive step; trash view scoped; counts update
expected_final: Note permanently removed after empty; honest empty state after

workflow: Search journey across a tagged corpus with operators
ordered_actions: Search "tag:alpha" → open a result → edit it → Back → search quoted phrase → exclusion query -term → sort switch Title → verify order
expected_intermediate: Each operator narrows correctly (Phase 2 verified single actions); returning from the editor preserves the query
expected_final: Results reflect the edit; sort reorder visible

workflow: Saved view journey (filters → save → switch → growth)
ordered_actions: Filters → tag facet → Save as view… "V" → All notes → switch to V via chip → create a new matching note → verify it appears in V
expected_intermediate: View chip navigates; membership recomputed on requery
expected_final: New matching note included in the saved view

workflow: Revisions deep-dive (3 edits → list → restore oldest)
ordered_actions: Edit body v2 → wait → edit v3 → wait → Revisions panel lists entries → restore the v1 revision → verify content → new revision appended
expected_intermediate: Revision list grows per autosave; restore is itself revision-tracked
expected_final: Note content back to v1 text; revision history shows the restore

workflow: Settings journey (theme + toolbar groups + live effect + revert)
ordered_actions: Settings → dark theme → uncheck "tools" toolbar group → Save → open editor (group absent) → settings → re-enable + light theme → Save → verify
expected_intermediate: Settings apply to the live session without reload (QA-D03 regression); theme switches live
expected_final: Toolbar group visibility and theme follow the last saved settings
must_persist: Settings record; survives restart (verified in Phase 2 restart row)

workflow: Backup export → preview → restore (merge)
ordered_actions: Settings → Backup section → Export backup → download lands → preview the same file → Restore (merge) → verify notes intact
expected_intermediate: Export produces the ZIP; preview summarises counts honestly; merge restore runs
expected_final: Data intact after merge restore; no loss; honest errors on malformed files

workflow: Mid-edit navigation away and back
ordered_actions: Type a sentence → Back to notes immediately → reopen the note → verify the sentence (autosave) → open palette → run a command → back
expected_intermediate: No data loss on navigation; editor remounts with stored doc
expected_final: Content preserved through the round-trip

workflow: Smart-list navigation chain with selection resets
ordered_actions: All notes → select a card → Pinned → (selection reset) → Archived → Trash → All notes → verify list + selection state
expected_intermediate: Switching lists drops stale selection; each list scoped correctly
expected_final: Back at All notes with correct full list, no selection

workflow: Cancel flows leave state untouched
ordered_actions: Link dialog → Cancel; reminder dialog → Cancel; trash dialog → Cancel; settings with a toggle changed → Cancel; verify each
expected_intermediate: Every dialog closes without applying; settings revert (no save)
expected_final: Note/tag/reminder/settings unchanged after all cancels

workflow: Universal Escape dismissal across surfaces
ordered_actions: Open each surface (find bar, panels, settings, palette, reminders dialog) → Escape → verify closure order (topmost first)
expected_intermediate: Escape closes the topmost layer only; panels close after dialogs
expected_final: All surfaces dismissible by Escape (UX-01..05)

workflow: Second capture of the same link → Compare snapshots → Delete one
preconditions: Granted origin; duplicate policy allows re-capture
ordered_actions: Save a web page… with the SAME URL → duplicate decision (reuse/new) → snapshots panel shows entries → Compare… → delete one snapshot (confirm) → remaining verified
expected_intermediate: Duplicate policy surfaces its decision UI (or honest reuse); compare dialog renders both captures; delete confirms before removing
expected_final: One snapshot remains; link intact; exports still work
notes: Re-covers deferred QA-147 (Compare needs 2+ snapshots) and QA-149 (Delete + confirm)

workflow: Capture failure → honest state → retry succeeds
initial_state: A failed link exists (capture tab closed mid-flight in Phase 2 profile)
ordered_actions: Open the failed-capture note → Snapshots panel → retry capture → queue runs → link captured → snapshot artifacts appear
expected_intermediate: Failed state shows retry affordance; retry enqueues a real job
expected_final: Link transitions failed→captured; card chip updates from "Capture failed" to link indicator

workflow: Two-tab conflict resolution (save as duplicate)
initial_state: Two dashboard tabs open on the same note
ordered_actions: Tab A edits + waits (autosave) → tab B edits + waits → tab A edits again → conflict surfaced → choose reload/save-as-duplicate → verify both notes
expected_intermediate: Conflict detected via revision/version check; honest message names the other tab
expected_final: Resolution path completes without data loss (either reloaded current or duplicated)
notes: Extends QA-135 (which verified the conflict message itself)

workflow: Malformed import handled honestly
ordered_actions: Import a non-note JSON → inline error, no card → import a truncated file → error → import a valid lnwa-note → success
expected_intermediate: Each malformed input rejected with a truthful message; no partial note
expected_final: Only the valid import creates a note
must_persist: Nothing from the malformed attempts; the one valid note

workflow: Research session (capture → annotate → tag → remind → filter → search)
ordered_actions: Save a web page → open captured note → append annotations → tag "research" → add reminder → Back → Filters tag=research → open note → search annotation phrase → verify
expected_intermediate: A sustained multi-feature chain: capture feeds the editor; tags feed filters; content feeds search
expected_final: Every stage verifiable; ends at the annotated note via search

workflow: Journal continuity across browser restart
ordered_actions: Create "Journal" note → paste an image → type → navigate away → reopen + append → close browser → relaunch same profile → open note → verify all content
expected_intermediate: Autosave persists at each hop; restart preserves everything
expected_final: Note intact after restart: title, both text parts, image
